title: Dataset of Speech Production in intracranial Electroencephalography (SingleWordProductionDutch-iBIDS)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 10 Dutch-speaking patients with pharmaco-resistant epilepsy who read aloud 100 Dutch words presented one at a time on a screen. Intracranial EEG and pitch-shifted speech audio were recorded simultaneously, covering 1103 contacts across cortical and subcortical structures. The dataset supports research on speech production and speech decoding for brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: sEEG was recorded with Dixi Medical Microdeep shafts and Micromed SD LTM amplifiers at 1024 or 2048 Hz, with data downsampled to 1024 Hz. Participants read 100 Dutch words (2 s word display, 1 s fixation cross) while audio was recorded with a notebook microphone at 48 kHz. Neural, audio and stimulus streams were synchronised with LabStreamingLayer. Electrodes were localised with img_pipe by co-registering pre-implant T1 MRI with post-implant CT, and labelled using the Destrieux atlas.
